dimensions.name: focus
dimensions.why: §1.5 — 'Chat' is the only filled button; 'Make offer' is outlined and Like is an icon. §1.2 — the first screen is photo, title, price and details, nothing else competing.

dimensions.name: density
dimensions.why: §2 deciding — the photo takes about half the screen and the deciding facts follow (price, condition, brand, type, age range). The four attributes each take two lines, so the detail list runs long before anything else appears.

dimensions.name: hierarchy
dimensions.why: §1.6 — title, then price, then the 'Details' section with labels in grey over values in black: a clean ladder; the actions are pinned where the thumb is.

dimensions.name: clarity
dimensions.why: §1.13 — clear item, price and actions. 'Saves 1.04kg of CO2' sits beside the condition without saying how it's worked out (§1.12, true for everyone?).
